prompt: The paper schoolroom transforms into a 1920s factory apprentice workshop: tall factory windows, rows of machines receding, a grey-moustached master in a work apron showing two young Kazakh apprentices in flat caps how to operate a lathe, other apprentices at workbenches behind them. Stop-motion paper-cutout animation: layered paper pieces lift, slide, fold and re-cut themselves into the new scene, piece by piece, with soft shadows between the layers. Smooth continuous metamorphosis, calm and elegant, fixed camera, no flashes, no text, no letters. The left third of the frame stays plain pale paper.
